name: college-notes-sharing-portal
description: Full-stack College Notes Sharing Portal (NoteHub) for 5th-Semester CSE Minor Project

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const npm = isWin ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const s = spawn(npm, ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn(npm, ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: NoteHub Team
